question: List Non-Small Cell Lung Nivolumab, Ipilimumab trials where overall follow‑up exceeded 21 months.

gemini.answer: This query retrieves clinical trials for Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC) using both Nivolumab and Ipilimumab where the overall follow-up duration was greater than 21 months.
gemini.raw:
```json
{
  "sql": "SELECT \"nct\", \"author\", \"year\", \"pubmed_id\" \nFROM public.\"clinical_trials\"\nWHERE \"cancer_type\" ILIKE '%NSCLC%'\n  AND \"ici_name\" ILIKE '%Nivolumab%'\n  AND \"ici_name\" ILIKE '%Ipilimumab%'\n  AND \"follow_up_duration_overall_months\" > 21;",
  "answer": "This query retrieves clinical trials for Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC) using both Nivolumab and Ipilimumab where the overall follow-up duration was greater than 21 months.",
  "assumptions": ""
}
```
